decisions.subject: Existing official validation and rendering mechanisms
decisions.rationale: Reuse the coordinator's existing Pydantic BaseModel/CatalogSeed contract and static Pages builder. Official Pydantic model validation supports typed JSON and extra='forbid': https://docs.pydantic.dev/latest/concepts/models/ . Steward work introduces no proxy, wrapper, alternate schema, provider integration, generation call or canonical migration.

decisions.subject: Types and source instances
decisions.rationale: Introduce reusable semantic boundaries across the four cases. Actual record/trajectory/element IDs retain object identity, symbolic axes, information provenance, phase, evidence and uncertainty. One type can support several instances without establishing equality or shared parameters.

decisions.subject: General learned feature projection
decisions.rationale: A general learned feature-space projection encompasses declared linear, dense-network and source-specific nonlinear MLP specializations. Each concrete label preserves architecture and normalization; these labels have distinct meaning and no exact-synonym alias is asserted.

decisions.subject: Embedding lookup with declared normalization
decisions.rationale: Lookup followed by declared LayerNorm specializes the lookup boundary. Normalization remains explicit in the original operation and component. Raw shared output-head rows preserve their parameter semantics.

decisions.subject: Distribution law, parameters and realized values
decisions.rationale: Separate distribution specification, encoded distribution parameters and sampled values. Posterior z_s and ell keep distinct operands despite sharing a general realized-latent type. Their dimensions and decoder packing remain source-instance facts.

decisions.subject: InstructCell inference sampling and decoder packing
decisions.rationale: Overview describes condition-dependent isotropic Gaussian sampling; Methods names a fixed Gaussian z_s prior and separate log-normal ell prior. Preserve the original inference uncertainty and training/inference receipts. Exact latent-specific sampler equations and ell inference receipt remain unresolved.

decisions.subject: Initial query parameters and updated features
decisions.rationale: Initial learned parameter slots and computed output slots have separate types. ChatNT query count and resampled output count remain independent; multiple-sequence query sharing stays unresolved.

decisions.subject: Context-dependent resampled_nucleotide_embeddings label
decisions.rationale: The same exact label occurs in question-conditioned and unconditioned ChatNT trajectories. Leave it globally unmapped. A future context-aware binding review can type these instances without assigning one question-dependence meaning to every occurrence.

decisions.subject: ChatNT actual question representation and fine-tuning receipt
decisions.rationale: Question dependence is documented; the pilot English-embedding input is a provisional question-context representation and port. Do not upgrade it to verified structure. Prompt-side fine-tuning receipt leaves answer-prefix serialization, teacher forcing, roles and masks unresolved.

decisions.subject: RNA pathway scores to DCA condition conversion
decisions.rationale: Pathway-indexed scores and the documented RNA conditioning boundary remain separate. In full_2026-07-06__rec_003852 / pretrain_multimodal_dca, node rna_attention_condition remains the original instance consumed by attend_rna at port rna_stream_condition_boundary. RNA is documented as a DCA condition; the pilot preserves a boundary gap from pathway scores and unknown embedding/key/value construction. This context-specific instance carries no global source-label mapping. The unavailable internals are instance-level evidence uncertainty, so the candidate unresolved-condition representation block is removed. The original pilot node, evidence, uncertainty and real operand bindings remain unchanged. No conversion edge from pathway_scores to rna_attention_condition is established. Dedicated-stream W placement, gating, key/value construction and residual algebra remain unresolved.

decisions.subject: Structural VAE and semantic MUSK branches
decisions.rationale: Retain separate encoder and representation families for VAE structural latents and MUSK semantic conditions. Clean target-subset latents have no inferred noising edge. Fine-tuning dual conditioning supplies no automatic inference persistence.

decisions.subject: Independent gene identity, expression and reveal status
decisions.rationale: Separate the computed contributions and raw shared parameter table. Keep unknown combination algebra as an opaque documented combiner boundary; initial CLS parameter remains independent of computed final CLS features.

decisions.subject: Phase-specific availability and loss-side targets
decisions.rationale: During NTC adaptation, cross-attention is bypassed and frozen, context is absent and an independent target set supplies MMD supervision. Training target reveals and inference predicted reveals keep their provenance. Do not insert masks, priors or targets into a generative receipt based on their presence elsewhere in a sample.

decisions.subject: X-Cell and Ultra output heads
decisions.rationale: Linear scalar output and tied parameter-row projection keep separate concrete recipient boundaries. Missing equations and divergent source scaling wording require further review; no common output-head mapping is imposed.

decisions.subject: Cumulative inference feedback versus adaptation
decisions.rationale: Document a current-to-next recurrent update motif with real pilot operands. Preserve earlier accepted values and the separate terminal full prediction. NTC adaptation uses single-step output; no cumulative loop is attached to its receipt.

decisions.subject: Unreviewed long-tail labels
decisions.rationale: Leave labels without an explicit exact mapping available for builder proposals. Broad labels such as hidden_state, conditioning_vector, generative_state and RNA embeddings remain unmapped pending semantic review. C2S baseline recipes, image inversion, continuous IHC translation, dataset collation, teacher alignment and many architecture internals are outside the reviewed reusable seed. Global exact-label mappings are scoped to the four pilot records and are not transferable automatically beyond them. Every additional record requires fresh source-backed semantic and context-collision review before applying these mappings.

decisions.subject: Composite structure support
decisions.rationale: Composite composition arrays list constituent types in pedagogical motifs, including parallel branches. Array order supplies no sequential dependency; render constituent types without sequential arrows. Ordered real step IDs and complete bindings live in examples and preserve actual operand edges and boundary gaps. Quotes supply mechanism evidence; they establish no formal proof of graph structure, cross-context tensor identity, shared parameters or omitted edges.

decisions.subject: Alias policy
decisions.rationale: No exact-synonym aliases were established in this review. Alias arrays remain empty. Compatible general types and concrete specializations use explicit mapping relations; any future alias requires a source-backed boundary-equivalence decision.
